subject.title: fix(codex): surface native subagent task updates

question: Should Codex native subagent mirror tasks inherit channel visibility from the final parent delivery route, including cron/direct embedded runs with explicit routes, while internal/orphan flows stay silent?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent delivery policy affects channel noise and scheduled-run visibility; code alone cannot choose that product boundary.

options.title: Parent-route gated visibility
options.body: After fixing the stale-route bug, inherit requesterOrigin only from the final resolved parent delivery route and keep flows without a deliverable route silent.

options.title: Broad routed-run visibility
options.body: Allow all explicit routed cron/direct/gateway runs to surface native Codex subagent task state, accepting additional channel noise as intentional.

options.title: Keep mirror quiet
options.body: Reject Codex native child task delivery for now and leave #87666 open for a different UI or task-surface design.

recommendation.title: Parent-route gated visibility
recommendation.body: After fixing the stale-route bug, inherit requesterOrigin only from the final resolved parent delivery route and keep flows without a deliverable route silent.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Codex native task mirror and is the clearest owner for its delivery policy.
